_doc: Method C — adaptive_span with explicit span_refinement_level. Invoke with: python run_patient.py ubend --config cases_input/ubend/config_adaptive_span.json. Identical physics / BCs / WK auto-calc to config.json — only the mesh block changes.

case_info.description: U-bend 1-cycle laminar pulsatile — Method C (cells_across_span=17, span_refinement_level=1)

mesh._doc: Method C: target 17 cells across the local lumen via snappy insideSpan refinement at level 1. With span_level pinned to 1 (×2 multiplier), blockMesh density = ceil(17/2) = 9 cells/D, achievable = 9 × 2 = 18 cells across span. The auto-planner is bypassed because span_refinement_level is explicit. surfaceRefinementLevels is independent (near-wall only).

geometry._doc: reference_radius_strategy='max' (default) anchors the background-mesh sizing to the largest vessel. For the single-tube ubend this is the inlet (27.4 mm). On a multi-branch aorta, switch to 'min' if you need every branch resolved to the cells_across_span target.
